taxonomy_name: CV_AI Recruitment and System Integration Taxonomy
design_principles: Certification does not equal practical competency.
Keyword occurrence does not equal experience.
Career function is independent from technology.
Technical and non-technical occupations are parallel branches.
Evidence must be preserved before interpretation.
Semantic interpretation should use the complete CV context.
CMC-specific system integration knowledge is an extension layer.
Taxonomy identity must remain separate from competency assessment.
Human review remains available for ambiguous cases.

top_level_branches.name: Technical / Technology
top_level_branches.description: Technology, engineering, infrastructure, software and technical system integration domains.

top_level_branches.name: Business / Corporate
top_level_branches.description: Business, corporate, administrative and operational career domains.
